<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4H1Mzs/wbwriter/main/Assets/logo-mark-1024.png" width="72" align="right" alt="WBWriter">

### What's new

- **Almost invisible chrome.** The hatching around the board and the board border are now barely visible. They're just enough to show where the board ends. The status line is as faint as the corner logo: it's there when you look for it and out of the way otherwise. Messages from web control stay bright.
- **Set the web control port and PIN before turning it on.** Both fields are always shown in the setup window, so you can pick a free port first.

### Download

WBWriter 1.1.1 or later offers this update by itself at launch. Otherwise download **`WBWriter-1.3.1.dmg`** (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized), open it and drag WBWriter into Applications.

Linux and Windows are coming soon.
